name: SafeAgentBench
summary: Evaluates embodied language-model agents on hazardous task instructions in AI2-THOR, comprising detailed, abstract and long-horizon tasks.
numbers: 750 tasks, 10 hazard categories; best baseline rejects 10% of detailed hazardous tasks

why.dex: 17 high-level actions over a scripted controller.
why.cog: Must notice the hazard inside the request.
why.xr: Includes deliberate requests to cause fire, poisoning or injury.
